scenes.title: Four stops
scenes.layout: horizontal ProgressRail with four stop markers; purple module colour

scenes.title: Your ID card
scenes.layout: marker 1 active; ID badge illustration; benefit chips

beats.do: badge swings in on its lanyard (rotate −8°→0, spring)
benefits wheel spins in 90° and settles; insurance segment highlights

scenes.title: Oracle
scenes.layout: marker 2 active; abstract Oracle tile (wireframe style, labelled 'training wireframe'); three request cards fly into it
onScreenText: If it's a request, it needs a record

beats.do: rail marker 2 fills; Oracle tile scales in
three cards arc into the tile, 120 ms stagger

scenes.title: Qiwa

beats.do: contract card lifts out of the Oracle tile
card slides to the Qiwa tile and a tick draws

scenes.title: Your licence

beats.do: countdown ring sweeps to 30 and turns magenta (warning colour, with ⚠ icon and words)

scenes.title: Where to look
scenes.layout: all four stops lit; Dr. Omar half-body right

beats.do: the four markers light in sequence
